hypotheses.mechanism_label: Piecewise-Arrhenius Grotthuss with single H-bond threshold
hypotheses.description: Proton transport via H-bond network restructuring with a single threshold near T_break.

hypotheses.mechanism_label: Single percolation threshold with vehicular step-up

hypotheses.mechanism_label: Cooperative VTF above Tg, no sharp transition
hypotheses.description: Cooperative segmental motion governs proton mobility; σ(T) is smooth with no distinct transition.
hypotheses.key_prediction: VTF fit dominates throughout the range; T_break is a fit artifact.
